title: Not the old tupperware pitchers we grew up with sadly!
text:
Not the old tupperware pitchers we grew up with sadly!. I was excited to try this out but instantly I was let down when I pulled it out of it's bag. You can tell it's not the same quality as the old tupperware pitchers that we grew up with that lasted for so many years that many of them found new lives in thrift shops. This pitcher is thicker plastic which is nice but the lid isn't going to really do much other than possibly keep your drink fresh? If you tilt it- it WILL leak. The airtight lid goes in place and you can very easily just lift it right back up. The old ones were much better and would really stick!

Overall it's a decent pitcher but it should be more like $20 max. I definitely wouldn't pay $45 for this!
